decision: 5 Second time penalty. (1 penalty point awarded, 6 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Although the driver of car 31 did not gain a position, he still gained an advantage in that he was able to retain his position in front of car 2, when, if he had not gone off the track, he would not have been able to do so. It was noted the team was advised by the Race Director that car 31 could give back its position but this was not possible as further overtaking had occurred.
event_name: Document 36 Date 25 November 2018 Time 18:31 2018 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 22 - 25 November The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 31 left the track in turn17 and retained his position and therefore gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
team: Racing Point Force India F1 Team
